name: slate
title: Slate
description: A clapperboard rises over the page, claps, and is pulled away from the next one. The stick opens first and the new page shows in the gap. GSAP.
docs:
Wrap your layout with the transition. This is the only step:

  // app/layout.tsx
  import { SlateTransition } from "@/components/slate"

  export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
    return (
      <html lang="en">
        <body>
          <SlateTransition>{children}</SlateTransition>
        </body>
      </html>
    )
  }

Your existing <Link>s are intercepted automatically.

A clapperboard rises into frame from the bottom with its stick open and
covers the page. The stick claps shut — that is the moment the route swaps
behind it. The slate settles, the stick lifts and the new page shows in the
gap above the board, then the whole slate is pulled down out of frame.
Nothing fades. angle sets how far the stick opens, stick its height in vh,
hinge which end it pivots on, settle how far the slate drops after the clap,
drift the sideways arc of the hand, and shake the jolt at the impact.

Colour: two palettes ship as classes — palette="ink" (default, black board
with white stripes) and "chalk" (the reverse). For anything else pass
palette="custom" and set --slate-board and --slate-stripe yourself in
components/transitions.css.

Note: browser back/forward is not animated, and the route does not start
loading until the leave phase finishes (~0.9s).
